turns.text:
hi can u edit two things pls. first kenji's text so i know what im replying to: "hey i can still do my tue/thu ride in my hatchback, pick you up 10:20 for chem? lmk if u need anything else or if that doesnt work"

my reply draft: "yes pls that works, thank u so much, ill be outside at 10:20" can u make it sound less stiff

Sure, here are a few options, from casual to warmer:

- "yes pls, that works! see you at 10:20 ☕"
- "perfect, ill be outside at 10:20. thank u!!"
- "you're the best, yes to Tue/Thu rides. ill be outside at 10:20, ty!"

Your draft was already clear and polite, so these just loosen the tone. Want me to add an offer to buy him a coffee?

the first one is perfect. ok second thing, sam wants me to take another saturday swap and i keep saying yes. he still owes me two saturdays from september. i opened at 6:30 today and im working tmrw too so im kinda done

my draft: "hey sam, maybe? i'll see how my week goes and let u know.."

can i soften it more so it doesnt sound mean

Your draft is already soft, but "maybe" may leave him thinking you'll probably say yes, which could mean more asking later. Here are a few versions, from gentlest to clearest:

- "hey sam, i don't think i can swing another saturday right now, sorry!"
- "hey sam, i can't take this one. i've got a lot on with school and work, hope u find someone!"
- "hey sam, i can't cover this one. also, still waiting on the two saturdays you owe me from september, can we sort those out first?"

If you'd rather keep it light, the first is kind without promising anything. Want a warmer or more playful version? I can also soften it further, though more padding can make the answer harder to read.
ooh the third one is good but kinda direct.. can u make it a little softer. like maybe not a hard no

Here's a softer version that still doesn't commit you:

"hey sam, i'm pretty wiped this weekend so i can't do this one, sorry!! if u wanna swap back one of the two saturdays from september sometime, im happy to figure that out together 🙂"

It keeps the no gentle and turns the owed shifts into an easy offer. If you want it even less firm, you could end with "let me know what works for you," but I'd keep the first line as is so it's clear.
ok i'll send that. thanks!! ok im gonna go to bed now 🫠
Sounds good. Good luck with the Sunday shift, and sleep well! ☕
